findings.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation of liability or exclusion of indirect damages, leaving both parties exposed to unlimited liability. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with the usual uncapped carve-outs.

provided, that the Globix Agreement is terminated on or prior to the Effective Date

(c) Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. Neither Party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality or data security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to pay fees due under Section 3 shall not be treated as damages subject to the cap.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual liability cap and damages exclusion, as the Agreement is currently silent and liability is unlimited on both sides. Indemnification, confidentiality/security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap; our fallback is a mutual cap at 12 months' fees.

findings.rationale: There is no indemnity from HDI, even though HDI builds, hosts and operates the Site and handles Company user data. We require a Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, data breaches and wilful misconduct.

9A. Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Site, the hosting services or any deliverable provided by HDI infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right (other than claims arising solely from the Content or Marks provided by the Company); (b) HDI's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorised access to or disclosure of Company Confidential Information or user data caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall give prompt notice of the claim, HDI shall control the defence, and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at HDI's expense.

10. General Provisions.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have inserted HDI's indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, data incidents and wilful misconduct; the Agreement currently has no indemnity in either direction. Standard notice/control/cooperation procedure included.

findings.quote: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
findings.rationale: Section 6.1 restricts the Company from participating in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or products "substantially similar", which is an open-ended field-of-use restraint on our own business. We narrow it to a single competing self-contained site, with carve-outs and a performance-based exit.

replacement.oldText: Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
replacement.newText: Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not operate a self-contained web site offering Deerskin Products directly to consumers on the Internet, provided that this restriction (a) does not apply to the Company's internal development activities or to any business or web site acquired by the Company, (b) does not apply after expiration or termination of this Agreement, and (c) terminates automatically if HDI fails to perform its obligations under Section 1.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the products or projects we may pursue, particularly one extending to "substantially similar" products. We have narrowed it to the single competing site the arrangement is intended to protect, limited to the term, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions and an exit if HDI underperforms.

findings.quote: HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet
findings.rationale: Section 6.1 gives HDI exclusivity over our own "Deerskin" brand online with no performance-based exit. Our redline to Section 6.1 (see NONCOMPETE) removes this exclusivity; if HDI insists, it must be limited to Deerskin Products, capped at 12 months and terminate automatically on HDI's failure to perform.

findings.quote: HDI agrees that it shall promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than it promotes HDI's
findings.rationale: The only "no less favorably" obligation runs in our favour (HDI's promotional commitment); no MFN burdens the Company. No change required.
No non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binds the Company. Acceptable as drafted.

findings.rationale: The Termination Payment is a Customer-payable penalty measured against Net Sales (our revenue), not fees, and is uncapped in amount. We cap it at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.

replacement.newText: the amount of which shall not exceed the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months immediately preceding the Termination Date, which shall be HDI's sole and exclusive remedy in respect of such termination
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We do not pay liquidated damages, and a payment calculated on our Net Sales rather than fees is disproportionate. If an early-termination amount is unavoidable we cap it at three months' fees as the sole remedy.

findings.quote: (a) Each Party represents and warrants to the other Party that (1) it is a corporation organized, validly existing and in goodstanding under the laws of the state of its incorporation;
findings.rationale: Section 9 contains only mutual corporate-authority warranties; there is no performance or conformance warranty from HDI for the development and hosting services and no remedy. We insert the standard services warranty.

replacement.oldText: (4) the execution of this Agreement will not conflict in any way with any pre-existing agreements or understandings of the Party with any person or entity.
replacement.newText: (4) the execution of this Agreement will not conflict in any way with any pre-existing agreements or understandings of the Party with any person or entity. HDI further warrants that (i) the design, development, hosting, maintenance and management of the Site will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each deliverable will conform in all material respects to its specifications and documentation; and (iii) the Site and any software provided by HDI will contain no viruses or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at HDI's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services or deliverable.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We need a performance and conformance warranty with a real remedy (90 days for deliverables) plus a no-malicious-code warranty; the current section covers only corporate authority.

findings.rationale: There is no insurance clause, although HDI hosts our site and processes customer and order data. We insert our standard short insurance paragraph.

replacement.newText:
10.8 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where HDI processes Company Data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

10.9 Headings; Counterparts.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] Vendors that host our site and process our customer data carry CGL, E&O and cyber cover; fallback is E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.

findings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
findings.rationale: Fees are a revenue share on actual Net Sales with no minimum purchase or take-or-pay commitment on the Company. Note the apparent typo "(3016)" for "(30%)" should be corrected.

The termination provisions say nothing about return of Company Data or transition of the Site, even though HDI holds the site, content and user data. We insert a transition-assistance and data-return paragraph.

replacement.oldText: (c) The Termination Payment, if any, shall be payable by the Company in eight (8) equal payments to be made quarterly, commencing thirty (30) days after the termination date.
replacement.newText:
(c) The Termination Payment, if any, shall be payable by the Company in eight (8) equal payments to be made quarterly, commencing thirty (30) days after the termination date.

4.3 Transition Assistance; Data Return. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates, including cooperation in transferring the Site and the URL to the Company or its designee; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Content and Company Data (including user, customer and order data) in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Company Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] On exit we need our data back in a usable format and reasonable transition help (fallback 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days); the Agreement is currently silent.
